description: Pseudo-random vector triples (xorshift32, seed 20261114, magnitudes 1e-3…1e8 per vector, independent signs) for the identity checks of tolerances.md §7 VT-01, and the exact special inputs of §1.
status: Committed before any engine run on it (tolerances.md §4.1 item 1; ML-TASK-018 part C phase 1). Not yet reviewed or approved; immutable once approved, corrections create a new version (plan §6).

powerOfTwoScaling.rule: scale(k, x) === [k·x0, k·x1, k·x2] exactly for k a power of two (no overflow/underflow)

exactCases.source: docs/verification/tolerances.md revision 3 (approved by the owner 2026-11-13) §1 "Special inputs to vector utilities" (exact; norms require a correctly rounded square root, assumption A2)

producedBy.independence: packages/astrodynamics and packages/simulation not read and not run (ADR-003); references import nothing from the engine.
producedBy.numberFormat: Every number is the shortest decimal that round-trips to the binary64 value; JSON.parse restores the exact binary64. Signs of zero are not preserved (−0 written as 0) except where a value is encoded as {"$number": "-0"}.

method.quantities: (a) |a·(a × b)| and |b·(a × b)| / (‖a‖²‖b‖ resp. ‖a‖‖b‖²); (b) |a·(b × c) − b·(c × a)| / (‖a‖‖b‖‖c‖); (c) |‖x‖_engine − ‖x‖_test| / ‖x‖_test; (d) |‖x/‖x‖‖ − 1| (norm of the engine unit vector evaluated by the test)

tolerance.record: docs/verification/tolerances.md revision 3 (approved by the owner 2026-11-13) §7 VT-01
